Six level-1 characters — complete creation walkthroughs

Created from the approved catalog on main after PRs #1132–#1158. These are worked character choices, not new rules, random samples or combat-balance results. Every character stops at level 1. Follow the linked sheet for both complete DP ledgers, origin pairs, ancestry traits, signature, equipment and learned-card checklist.

@UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.6f065eb211ba38bd.JournalEntryPage.73eccfaaa92efbdf]{Oren Brass}Investigator-tinkerHuman Intellect1779 / 1013 / 1315 / 15

Pip, Oren and Vaelis use the 1-DP shared abilities to spend their odd creation points.

All start at full HP, Grit 2, no wounds and no death marks. Unspent creation DP expires separately at each stage. Ancestry and culture are independent: Mara is a human of Forest Communities, and Oren is a human raised in Deep Halls.

What was checked

- All attributes are −2 through +2, total +3, and satisfy the chosen class minima. - Each origin pair exists in its source. Only those rank-1 grants qualify level-0 purchases; no class rank or purchased rank is borrowed from level 1. - Every purchased card is Novice. Requirements are held before each purchase; class-granted disciplines are valid and distinct. Duplicate ranks yield 1 DP each at the correct stage, never rank 2. - Class Home/Adjacent/Foreign prices and all running balances were checked. - All six signatures belong to the chosen class and level. No extra signature purchases or advanced-tier cards are assumed. - HP, Speed, capacity and carried Bulk were recomputed. Each item is traced to an explicit grant; compatible duplicate grants are counted once. Described weapons use the cards’ mechanics, not statistics imported from their appearance. - Oren’s six recipe choices are distinct and compatible. Recipe knowledge does not supply ingredients or finished products. Other characters have no recipe grants.

These checks were run against the source Markdown with a temporary validation script and followed by a reading of the sheets. The normal catalog audit also passes. This checks these six builds, not every possible creation route. All purchased disciplines here are rank 1: buying deeper ranks without access to higher-tier cards did not serve these particular concepts.

At the table

These examples show particular choices, not compulsory builds. Lira remains a Blade archer; the Warden is another option for a dedicated wilderness hunter. Pip fights with Guile, Oren with Knowledge, and Mara can heal or change form.

Borin’s weapon and shield and Lira’s bow leave no free potion hand. Equipment, materials, coins and Bulk are recorded in each shopping ledger. Recipe knowledge does not create supplies. Creation DP remainders expire at each stage.

These six examples do not establish comparative class strength or encounter CV.
